Notes

Rahemos, a great conjurer, was sentenced to be locked away, after his part in the conspiracies against the pharaoh. He is guarded by a Warlock and a Magicthrower. He spawns even with players in his room.

One of the Pharaohs of The Ancient Tombs Quest.

Location

Behaviour

Malicious, he will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

Strategy

He uses strong magic attacks, so use blockers to run around him and distance fighters to fire on him. Due to his high magic resistance and notable weakness to physical damage, it is highly recommended for mages to use Explosion runes (Druids can combine this with Physical Strike). Higher level knights can easily solo Rahemos with a couple of quick Fierce Berserks, Front Sweeps and an Annihilation spell. A Demon Skeleton can be summoned to draw attention from the Magicthrower as well as deal extra damage to Rahemos.
